makeup_policy: • Mid-Sem Exam has one make-up. This means, that a student can abstain herself/himself (on valid reasons) in this Test. This makeup would be conducted immediately after regular mid-sem exam and would include complete syllabus. Of course, the student would apply for the makeup in advance with documentary proof. • Only on producing documentary proof of possible absence, which proves that student would be physically unable to appear for the test/exam, the decision of granting the makeup will be taken. • Prior Permission of AGSRD is required to get makeup for the comprehensive exam.
